tools.description: Step 1 of 2 to get an API key, no browser. Returns { message }: the exact text your wallet must sign with personal_sign (EIP-191). It is valid for 10 minutes and moves no funds.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trnch_register_message · Private data: trnch_check, trnch_quote, trnch_scan_wallet, trnch_top_volume, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_confirm.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trnch_register_message · Private data: trnch_check, trnch_quote, trnch_scan_wallet, trnch_top_volume, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_confirm

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
